race.title: Wrexham Lager Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Those with chase experience look of most interest here, with ESCORT'KHEOPS chief amongst them after his third here last month. Crystello will be suited by the return to 3m and rates as a potential improver, with Knead A Win also meriting respect on his chase bow. ESCORT'KHEOPS (FR) CRYSTELLO (IRE) KNEAD A WIN (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Knead A Win (7/2), Joltin N Jiving (5/1), Escort'kheops (5/1), De Kingpin (6/1), Crystello (7/1), Skuna Bay (10/1), Sole Solution (10/1), Douglas Hyde (12/1), Leading Choice (20/1), Patrick's Wells (20/1), Top Guy (25/1), Outer Banks (25/1)
